column1: # nv-coverage.tsv — the RATIFIED mutation-coverage census of the kit control set (PR 10,
# CONFORMANCE-MUTATION-COVERAGE-GAP). One row per control script that non-vacuity.sh targets or
#   KILLED    = a composite mutant of the FAIL path made its own --selftest fail (load-bearing).
#   UNCOVERED = the sweep could not reach a CERTAIN verdict; the reason is the sweep's own text.
#   EXCLUDED  = no --selftest substring at all, so there is no oracle to mutate. Membership-only:
#               these appear in no tally and are never verdict-compared.
# MEMBERSHIP is re-derived and diffed on every verify run (non-vacuity.sh --coverage-census,
# grep-class, zero mutants). VERDICT CELLS are diffed against the sweep's own tally whenever a sweep
# runs (shard-scoped), so a hand-flipped cell reds on the PR that flips it.
# HONEST CEILING: one COMPOSITE mutant per file — a KILLED proves at least one mutable site is
# observed, not all of them, and it names no site.
# CAPTURE ENVIRONMENT (the verdicts at :242 run-location and :228 region-ambiguity are
# environment-sensitive, so this baseline is PROVISIONAL until the introducing PR's own CI sweep
# confirms it — that sweep tally-diffs these cells and reds on any disagreement):
#   method: sh conformance/non-vacuity.sh --shard i/8 for i in 1..8 (a true partition of the
#           unsharded target set, asserted by the F5b selftest leg); union = 86 targeted scripts,
#           78 KILLED · 0 SURVIVED · 8 UNCOVERED · 0 ERROR, plus the 5 EXCLUDED below.
